name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding Manager | Implementation, Partner-Driven Enrollment, Adoption KPIs
summary: Onboarding and implementation lead who takes customers from signed contract to launch and keeps adoption moving after. At Birdeye I onboarded 15-20 reseller partners and made sure each one got its own end customers set up on our listings solution, then tracked utilization to catch slow adoption early; I retained all but one (~94%). At Wix I carried up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets. At Solenzo I build systems for electrical, plumbing, and HVAC businesses, the trades that make up a property manager's vendor list.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for service businesses, including electrical, plumbing, and HVAC trades: kickoff, requirements, configuration, data setup, and training.
Built automated appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, reactivation of lapsed customers, and review requests across a 20+ workflow system.
Document every client interaction, configuration, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, and report progress with specific recommendations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 reseller partners and ensured every partner's end customers were set up on Birdeye's listings solution, the backbone of the offer, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that helped partners roll the product out to their own customers.
Shared structured onboarding feedback with Product and Engineering; tracked all activity in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 110% of implementation targets.
Ran onboarding calls as primary contact, aiming to launch simple builds on the first call and scoping multi-session plans for complex ones.
Led and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions and 1:1 coaching, and defined the Salesforce fields for onboarding workflows.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and guided onboarding and workflow design alongside the implementation team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold a loyalty and customer-engagement platform to small local businesses, up to 150 calls per day.
